name: TAM-E event phase operators
phase_rule: φ_event = φ_tense + φ_aspect + φ_mood + φ_modality + φ_evidentiality
equivalence_rule: Event equivalence requires compatible predicate frame, roles, polarity and TAM-E signature.
cross_language_note: Surface realization differs by language. Polish strongly encodes aspect in verb pairs. English uses auxiliaries. Spanish and French use rich tense/mood morphology. German uses auxiliaries and modal verbs.
